notes.title: Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara release date announcement
notes.notes:
Hello y'all! 

After an amazing and successful Kickstarter campaign we're so happy to announce the next step in our journey with this game: [b]Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara launches July 27[/b]! 🌴

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890287/9c1248df8e58bdd1186ed678d29f049f94a697a3.png[/img]

We are preparing everything to put the cherry on top of this development and the beginning of an exciting new adventure for many of you, so there is one last surprise! 

Next week the [b]Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara demo[/b] will be available for everyone [b]from Monday 19 to Sunday 25[/b]. If you like it, feel free to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819450/Koa_and_the_Five_Pirates_of_Mara/]add it to your wishlist[/url] to show your support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890287/dd3dfd1446900f1f636c30c6f1bd1f9721e7b6e7.png[/img]

Also, the [b]physical editions[/b] (both Standard and Collector's) will come in September 29th with our friends and publishers from Tesura Games - pre orders are [url=https://tesuragames.com/juegos/koa-and-the-five-pirates-of-mara/]now available[/url]!

Are you ready for your next summer adventure with Koa and Napopo? We are!
